name: Dong Xanh Park
kicker: Highland culture park on Quốc lộ 19
summary: Walk Dong Xanh Park, the highland culture grounds about 10 km from Pleiku. Stone elephants mark the gate, and the grounds hold rông houses, a lotus pond, and a wave pool. A one-pillar pavilion stands in the grounds. Hours, the gate fee, and how long to allow are Check on arrival.
getThere: About 10 km from central Pleiku along Quốc lộ 19, in An Phú
heroCaption: The one-pillar pavilion in Dong Xanh Park
body: Follow Quốc lộ 19 about 10 km from central Pleiku to An Phú. The park covers about 8 ha, set on the An Phú rice fields of about 14 ha. Stone elephants stand at the gate. Inside are rông and longhouse models, a lotus pond, a fossil tree from the Chư A Thai crater in Ayun Pa, and a water park with the first wave pool in the Central Highlands.

A one-pillar pavilion stands in the grounds, a single column under a curved roof, with the stair up one side. Boats, pedal boats, and fishing are on the water. Bungalows sit by a fish pond if you want the night in the park.
Hours, the gate fee, and how long to allow are Check on arrival. The ride from town is about 10 km. Minutes and the fare are Check on arrival.

figures.caption: The single column and the stair, from the front of the pavilion
figures.alt: One-pillar wooden pavilion on a carved column, with a stair and a red fence, in Dong Xanh Park

gettingThere: The park is in An Phú, Pleiku. From the center, follow Quốc lộ 19 about 10 km. Minutes and the fare are Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Pleiku
legs.body: By taxi or ride-hail along Quốc lộ 19, about 10 km to An Phú. Minutes and the fare are Check on arrival.
